name: Corvids of Ritou
source:
Typhoons and whirlwind swept across the Ritou Island chains almost annually where Megumi a native born lives. The wind brings with it massive amount of trash and debris from all over the wide pacific ocean into Ritou shores, where people named them Drift Items.

Most people only see Drift Items as trash, but some believe that these items are valuable. Megumi is one of them. She always collects Drift Items and brings them to her own warehouse. She cleans them, takes care of them, and sometimes uses the ones that are still functional.

One day her peaceful life of collecting items suddenly interrupted by two competitors from outside the islands.

Kuro is an archaeologist who is searching for valuable items that he can sell back in the city. Meanwhile, Jay is a man obsessed with the occult, especially the theory that Ritou Island is an island that is inhabited by an unknown extraterrestrial life.

These two men suddenly enter Megumi's life and change the way she sees the world. But who will be able to win Megumi's heart?

[From [url=https://hasyarin.itch.io/corvids-of-ritou]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
台风和旋风几乎每年都会席卷惠岛出生的利东列岛。风将广阔的太平洋上的大量垃圾和碎片带到了里东海岸，人们将它们称为“漂流物”。

大多数人只将漂移物品视为垃圾，但有些人认为这些物品很有价值。惠美就是其中之一。她总是收集漂流物品并将它们带到自己的仓库。她清洗、保养它们，有时还会使用那些仍然可以使用的东西。

有一天，她平静的收集物品生活突然被两名来自岛外的竞争对手打断。

库洛是一位考古学家，他正在寻找可以在城里出售的有价值的物品。与此同时，杰伊是一个痴迷于神秘学的人，尤其是日岛岛是一个居住着未知外星生命的岛屿的理论。

这两个男人突然进入了惠的生活，改变了她看待世界的方式。但谁能赢得惠美的心呢？

[来自[url=https://hasyarin.itch.io/corvids-of-ritou]itch.io[/url]]
